video_title: IN NOVEMBER 🍁 Kid's Book Read Aloud with Awnie | A Heartwarming Story About Fall and Family
description:
In November, the sky deepens, the air turns crisp, and the world feels full of quiet magic. Animals scurry to prepare for winter. Family kitchens fill with the scent of pumpkin and spice as they gather to count their blessings, share good food, laughter, stories, and gratitude. In November invites readers to slow down, snuggle up, and savor the gentle wonders of the season. In November is a tender celebration of the sights, sounds, and seasonal changes that make this time of thankfulness so special.

author: Emily Moffat
video_title: SCARED OF A BOO! 👻 A Musical Storytime About Bravery & Friendship with Awnie & Sunny's Songs
description:
Join me for a fun (and not-so-spooky!) read-aloud of Scared of a Boo! — a story about finding your courage, using your voice, and learning that it’s okay to feel a little scared sometimes.

In this special collaboration with Sunny’s Songs, a fabulous channel here on YouTube that creates fun and catchy music for kids, you'll experience this story through reading and song! 

💬 Do you ever feel shy about saying hello or worried about saying the right thing? You’re not alone — and Gabby the ghost knows exactly how that feels.

✨ After the story, sing along with Sunny’s Songs to Scared of a Boo!

💛 Parents & Teachers:
This story encourages emotional awareness, empathy, and social confidence in children — especially those who experience anxiety or sensory challenges.

You can check out more of their fun and engaging videos here: https://www.youtube.com/@SunnysSongs4Kids
